name: Product Classification 1
definition: Specifies attributes of a derivative based on Final ISDA Taxonomy v1.0 and Final ISDA Taxonomy v2.0 (https://www.isda.org/2018/02/20/final-isda-taxonomy-v1-0-and-final-isda-taxonomy-v2-0/).

AssetClass.name: Asset Class
AssetClass.definition: Asset class of the underlying of the derivative (e.g. Interest Rate, Commodity, Equity).

BaseProduct.name: Base Product
BaseProduct.definition: Market of the underlying product (IR Swap, Freight, Precious/Non Precious).

SubProduct.name: Sub Product
SubProduct.definition: Further details of the product type.

SubCommodity.name: Sub Commodity
SubCommodity.definition: Further details if the asset class is commodity.

TransactionType.name: Transaction Type
TransactionType.definition: Type of the transaction, for example, option, spot forward or exotic.
